title: Self-build brief: carry Mandates 75-81 and one-way publication to delegated agents
goal: Vision: V-4. The contract Susi prepends to every delegated coding task (susi_core::self_build::BRIEF) stops at Mandate 74. Bring it up to Mandates 75-81 and the one-way publication rule of Mandate 72 (CEO directive 2026-11-16), pointing at the mandate documents instead of restating them, without growing first-party runtime Rust beyond its lean ceiling: cut sentences the brief states twice to make room.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs (BRIEF and its unit tests), every reader of the brief (susi-gawd-swarm dag, susi-gawd-agents external peers, crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_018.rs, tests/architecture_tests.rs), AGENTS.md, .agents/identity.json Mandates 72 and 75-81 and docs/ceo-mandate-75..81.md. The brief is extended in place and points at the existing mandate documents; no new module, dependency or harvest.

limitations: Text of the delegated-task contract and its tests only; no other runtime behaviour changes. Main is unqualified development, not a release.

First-party runtime Rust had 7 lines of headroom under its lean ceiling (301,993 of 302,000). The brief keeps its 102 source lines: two new items are paid for by removing sentences it stated twice (no-gate and exact-tree rules in the preamble and item 7, the storage rule in items 10 and 11, worktree isolation in item 11). The unit test grows by 4 lines, so runtime Rust is now 301,997.

The unit test pins the new header range, the Mandate 81 pointer, pure Apache-2.0 only, the Susi Board, the reuse decision and one-way publication. The agent-root, vision-cycle, ten-minute and release-sync clauses of item 12 are not pinned one by one, to stay under the ceiling.

The Susi Board could be read but not written from this cloud session (HTTP 403 on refs/board/* and refs/claims/*); no Claim or Landed item was posted and the record is closed by hand (Mandate 76 section 7).

susi-commercial-apps keeps two one-line stand-ins of the brief header that still read Mandates 43-72 (crates/susi-frontier-lab/src/migrated/mod.rs, crates/susi-commercial-license/src/substrate_compat.rs); they were not changed here.
